assets.caption: EXHIBIT 11-17 — Battery Limit Valving: Two-Level Rack (Process/Off-Site Elevation Change). Elevation drawing of a two-level pipe rack arrangement with battery limit valving at the elevation change between process and off-site sections; an operator figure stands on a platform between vertical riser pipes on each level. Upper level labeled HIGHER OFF-SITE RACK, lower level labeled LOWER OFF-SITE RACK; bottom label divides PROCESS (left) and OFF-SITE (right).
